# Air Quality Advisor v0.2.7 — Optional per-room Mold Indicator

This release adds an optional **calibrated mold indicator instead of raw room relative humidity (RH)**, based on the temperature/dew-point approach used by Home Assistant's [Mold Indicator integration](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/mold_indicator/). It remains off by default so existing users retain their previous humidity rules.

## First setup and per-room configuration

- On the first **Rooms** page, enable **Use mold indication instead of raw room RH** if you want to use estimated cold-surface relative humidity to trigger ventilation instead of the old 65% room-RH threshold.
- **Configure → Room settings — indoor air and mold**, the second entry, now offers each room's original sensor exclusions, a room-temperature sensor picker, and the **measured critical/coldest surface temperature in °C**.
- For calibration, measure the coldest wall/outer corner/window frame with a thermometer and enter its surface temperature while the room and outdoor temperatures are measured at the same time. At least 3°C difference between room and outside is required. The integration computes and persists the surface temperature calibration factor from these three temperatures.
- Existing calibration remains fixed when live weather/sensor values change. Use **Recalibrate** only when you measure the surface again. An empty measurement lets you calibrate the room later.
- To enable on an existing installation, open **Configure → Rooms**, switch on mold indication and save; then configure the room measurements under **Room settings**.

## Sensor averaging and recommendations

- All included room RH sensors are averaged, excluding **0%, unknown, unavailable, stale, nonfinite, negative or greater-than-100% readings**. Sensor exclusions are honored individually per room.
- The room's selected ambient temperature and associated weather provider's outdoor temperature, combined with the saved calibration, estimate cold-surface relative humidity using the Magnus dew-point formula. No individual extra Home Assistant Mold Indicator helpers are required.
- The default mold warning threshold is **70% estimated surface RH**, not 70% mold probability; adjust it in Advanced thresholds.
- If a temperature, humidity source, outdoor temperature or calibration is missing, mold indication is **unavailable/unknown** instead of falsely reporting safe or using raw RH.
- The dashboard displays the mold indication, number/average of valid room humidity sources and estimated surface temperature; indoor pollutant and bad-weather window decisions continue as before.
- Labels and room instructions are provided in all **38 supported languages**, including fully written guidance in Greek, German, English, French and Spanish.

## Existing behavior and installation

Mold mode is optional and disabled by default. No existing room selection, sensor exclusion, window contact, weather provider, Announcement Hub setting, automation, entity ID or history is migrated or removed. The 10-minute announcement recurrence and previously fixed event-loop-safe automatic alerts remain unchanged.

Update via **HACS → Air Quality Advisor → v0.2.7** and **restart Home Assistant** to load the updated Python and Lovelace card. Validation must pass Python regression tests, frontend tests, translations, Hassfest and HACS gates before publication.
